Emma — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the samples. A few notes and next steps: 

1) PO vs remittance field: Our payops system prefers the customer's PO number to appear in the "remittance_reference" field on the ACH when available — that makes automated PO matching across AP much cleaner. If you cannot put the full PO there due to bank truncation rules, please include the PO on the invoice and put the invoice number (INV-xxxxx) in the ACH description. Our reconciliation will use the invoice number as a fallback.

2) Beneficiary name truncation: We’ve seen the 23-char limit before. As long as the bank routing/account pair is correct and invoice number is present in the ACH description, we can match programmatically. Please also confirm that the account nickname (the name shown in your bank's portal) matches the legal name exactly — that helps our finance team.

3) DocuSign bank letter: I’ll trigger the bank-letter powerform for your signer and copy PayOps. Please sign within 72 hours so we can schedule micro-deposits next week. Link below.

4) Test micro-deposit and go-live: Once we have the signed bank letter and the ACH test is successful (two micro-deposits), we’ll aim for the first live payout in the next available run — typically within 5 business days of verification.

I’ve attached our internal onboarding checklist and a short example of how we want the remittance field populated:
- remittance_reference: PO-12345678 (preferred)
- ach_description: INV-2026-98765

If that works, sign the DocuSign and we’ll coordinate timing.

Link to DocuSign bank letter: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234
PayOps onboarding sheet: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD_payops_onboarding_sheet

Thanks,
Kimberly Park

Emma / Kimberly — all good from PayOps. Quick summary and next steps so we’re aligned: 

- Received: Signed bank letter (bank_letter_signed.pdf), W-9, voided check, ACH samples.
- Remit mapping: We will attempt PO match on remittance_reference first. If remittance_reference is truncated, our reconciler will use ach_description (invoice number) as fallback. That should cover the truncation scenario.
- Test run: Please send one test invoice with a test PO (suggested PO: PO-TEST-0001) and invoice INV-TEST-0001 so we can validate mapping in our staging before micro-deposits. If you send the invoice by EOD tomorrow, we’ll run the match and confirm results by EOD the following business day.
- Micro-deposits: Once mapping looks good, we’ll initiate micro-deposits (2 small deposits) on our test schedule. Expect those within 48 hours of the request.

I’ve added a PayOps playbook note to the onboarding sheet and set the HubSpot opportunity to the next step (Banking verification). HubSpot ref: 4521-Opportunity-SableLogistics.

If no blockers, Kimberly — I’ll mark the vendor as "Pending micro-deposit" and schedule the test run. Emma — send the test invoice to payops@redwood.ai with the PO/INV in the subject to speed processing.
